title: Getting around
summary: A one-minute look at each part of Hippo.

steps.title: Start on Overview
steps.text: Hippo scans every Claude and Cursor config file on your Mac. Anything over or near its size limit shows under Needs attention.

steps.title: Claude files
steps.text: Every Claude file, global first, then each project. Loads says when Claude reads it, and the gauge shows its size against the limit.

hotspots.label: Skills and docs this file points to

steps.title: Cursor files
steps.text: Cursor's side of the same projects. Not synced means Cursor can't see some of the Claude instructions or rules yet.

hotspots.label: Cursor's global rules live in its settings

steps.title: Skills
steps.text: Skills are step by step procedures. Only their short description loads every session; the rest loads when the task fits.

steps.title: Search everything
steps.text: Search finds text across every config, skill, rule and memory. Click a line to open the file right there.

hotspots.label: Click to jump to that line

steps.title: Where things live
steps.text: Pick the folder you start a session in to see exactly what loads, from your global folder down to the project.

hotspots.label: Everything that loads before you type

title: See what loads when you start in a folder
summary: Use the map to understand global vs project files.

steps.title: Choose your starting folder
steps.text: Claude and Cursor load different files depending on the folder you open. Pick the one you start in.

steps.title: Global files load first
steps.text: Your global CLAUDE.md and every skill's short description load in every session, wherever you start.

steps.title: Then each folder on the way down
steps.text: Claude also reads the CLAUDE.md in every folder above your project. Folders that load nothing still show, so you can see the whole path.

steps.title: The project and its memory load last
steps.text: The project's own instructions, always-on rules and memory index come last. Click any file to open it.

steps.title: Compare with Cursor
steps.text: Switch to Cursor to see what it loads in the same folder. Linking AGENTS.md and mirroring rules makes the two match.

title: Trim a file that's over its limit
summary: Move part of a long CLAUDE.md into a rule that only loads when needed.

steps.title: Spot the red file
steps.text: Red means over the limit. Here the storefront CLAUDE.md is well past the 200 line target, so Claude follows it less reliably.

steps.title: Open it
steps.text: The gauge updates as you edit, and the note says why the limit exists and where it comes from.

steps.title: Find the part to move
steps.text: Press Cmd+F and look for a section that only matters for some files. Here, Promotions only matters for the promo code.

steps.title: Create a rule for it
steps.text: On the Claude page, open the project and add a rule. Paste the section in, and add paths: so it only loads for matching files.

steps.title: Paste and save
steps.text: Save the rule, then cut the section from CLAUDE.md and save that too. The gauge goes green once it's under 200 lines.

type.text:
---
paths:
  - "src/promotions/**"
---

## Promotions

- Promotions note 1: keep this behavior when touching the promotions code.
- Promotions note 2: keep this behavior when touching the promotions code.
- Promotions note 3: keep this behavior when touching the promotions code.

title: Make a rule work in Claude and Cursor
summary: Write rules once on the Claude side and mirror them to Cursor.

steps.title: Rules live on the Claude side
steps.text: Write project rules in the project's .claude/rules folder. A rule without paths: loads every session; with paths: only for matching files.

steps.title: Cursor flags what it can't see
steps.text: On the Cursor page, a project with Claude rules that Cursor doesn't have yet shows Not synced.

steps.title: Mirror the rules
steps.text: Mirror rules to Cursor creates a matching Cursor rule for each Claude rule. paths: becomes Cursor's globs.

hotspots.label: Done: one Cursor rule per Claude rule

steps.title: Keep editing the Claude rule
steps.text: From now on, edit only the Claude rule and mirror again. Hippo only updates the copies it made, never Cursor rules you wrote by hand.

title: Undo a bad edit
summary: Bring back an earlier version of any file.

steps.title: Open History
steps.text: Every save keeps the version before it. Open History from the editor of the file you want to restore.

steps.title: Load a version
steps.text: Loading a version puts it in the editor so you can read it first. Nothing changes on disk yet.

hotspots.label: You're looking at the old version

steps.title: Save to restore it
steps.text: Save to put that version back. The version you replaced is kept too, so you can always undo the undo.

title: Stay on top of it with alerts
summary: Get notified when a file crosses a limit or a project drifts from Cursor.

steps.title: Turn alerts on
steps.text: Turn on alerts and Open Hippo at login. Hippo checks every 5 minutes from the menu bar and tells you when something gets worse.

steps.title: An alert brings you here
steps.text: Each alert matches an item on Overview: what's wrong, how far over, and a click to open the file. You also get one summary a day while something still needs attention.
